overall.verdict: Mobile light is a coherent, trustworthy money app with a real total, bilateral notch bars, and receipts tied to frames — but the light theme still leans on white cards, pills, and repeated numbers, so it feels like a clean fintech prototype rather than a quiet premium surface. Visceral scale is taught well in Settings and on Hub One, then abandoned on Pay, Swap, receipts, and most Activity rows.
priority_fixes: Enforce one receipt component (Pay sheet + Activity) with frame, proof chip, verified line, and a global-scale bar under the amount; delete stray ticks and the 3006 ms flex.
Draw every money bar at 1px=$50 from a shared origin (Home total, token, Hub One, Recent, Activity); $25 must be a 2px min mark, $10,000 = 200px — never a full-width accent rule.
Cut repeated chrome: Home legend under the total, hub pills, BALANCES debug meta, Receive’s three copy verbs, Pay’s wrapped address and duplicate Instant rows.
Swap must not ship You receive 0.00 / dead pastel CTA / no bar; quote or block, and show the Hub One send-room bar on the pay leg.
Light theme: one #F4F5F7 page, fewer white nested cards, 96px tab-bar insets, QR fully on first Receive viewport, Theme selected state with contrast, recovery phrase not equal to Lock.
